facts.fact: LeFisk describes ATOM as the tax directorate's online filing (tele-declaration) system already in use for declarations, before the new registrations platform; no date is given, so the article's published date is used.
LeFisk reports that registration duties for 3 public-procurement acts are assessed and paid online through the tax directorate DGI platform registrations.dgi.cm, by mobile money or DGI OTP.
